name: Astoria: Fate's Kiss
source:
The heroine is an ordinary associate at an extraordinary organization. Despite the less than everyday nature of her work, the heroine’s life remains largely mundane until five beautiful mythical beings approach her for her help. Guided by the player’s choices, the heroine must face otherworldly challenges and find love in their midst.

[Source: [url=http://www.voltage.co.jp/en/p-release/150716.html]Voltage[/url]]

Originally called Labyrinths of Astoria.
translation:
女主角是一个非凡组织中的普通职员。尽管工作远非日常，她的生活大体仍然平淡，直到五名美丽的神话生物前来请求她帮助。女主角将在玩家选择的引导下，面对异世界的挑战，并在他们之间寻找爱情。

[来源：[url=http://www.voltage.co.jp/en/p-release/150716.html]Voltage[/url]]

本作原名为《Astoria迷宫》。
